newsitem.title: USA: Columbus Circle names Connecticut treasurer as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Columbus Circle names Connecticut treasurer as CEO.

text.p: Columbus Circle Investors said on Thursday the investment firm appointed Christopher Burnham, currently treasurer of the State of Connecticut, as president and chief executive officer.

Burnham is expected to formally join Columbus Circle in the third quarter to oversee strategic planning, market development and all major administrative operations of Columbus Circle, which manages $11 billion in assets for institutions and individuals.
He will also be one of nine managing directors of the firm, the company said in a statement.
Burnham was elected state treasurer of Connecticut in 1994.
